rule_trigger: SageMaker on-demand spend > $500/month for 30 days → recommend SageMaker Savings Plan purchase.

technology: AWS EBS; Azure Managed Disk; GCP Persistent Disk; OCI Block Volume
metric_name: Disk attachment status; Disk creation date; Disk size (GB)

native_api_name: OCI: ListBootVolumes + ListBootVolumeAttachments API (noAttachment = true)

native_api_name: AWS: EC2 DescribeVolumes (volumeType; iops; size) | CloudWatch VolumeReadOps + VolumeWriteOps namespace=AWS/EBS
rule_trigger: Volume type = gp2 → always recommend review for gp3 migration. For io1/io2: avg actual IOPS < 33% of provisioned IOPS for 30 days → reduce provisioned IOPS.
notes: gp2 → gp3 migration: 20% cheaper; 3000 free IOPS included. Zero risk migration. Batch identify all gp2 volumes.

technology: AWS AMI/Snapshot; Azure Snapshot; GCP Snapshot; OCI Snapshot

technology: AWS S3; Azure Blob; GCP Cloud Storage; OCI Object Storage

rule_trigger: Object not accessed in 30+ days → recommend IA tier. 60+ days → Glacier/Archive. No lifecycle rule configured → recommend lifecycle rule creation.
notes: AWS S3 Storage Lens is free at account level. Last access time tracking in Azure must be explicitly enabled.

metric_name: Lifecycle policy existence; Object age; Last access time
native_api_name: OCI: GetBucketLifecyclePolicy + ListObjects API
rule_trigger: No lifecycle policy configured on bucket AND objects > 30 days old → recommend lifecycle policy enabling.

rule_trigger: Monitoring plugin disabled on compute instance → recommend enabling.

notes: AWS Config rules can enforce tag compliance. Azure Policy. GCP Organization Policy.

native_api_name: AWS: Cost Anomaly Detection API GetAnomalies | Azure: Cost Management Alerts API | GCP: Billing Budget API alerts
rule_trigger: Spend > 2σ above rolling 7-day baseline → alert with anomaly details.
notes: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection is free. Azure and GCP budget alerts are free.

metric_name: SGA_TARGET; SGA_MAX_SIZE; Buffer Cache Hit Ratio; Physical Reads
metric_collection_method: DB Observability Agent (Oracle EM or AWR query)
agent_name: Oracle Enterprise Manager Agent (deployed on DB server) OR direct AWR query (SELECT * FROM v$sga_dynamic_free_memory; v$instance_recovery)
rule_trigger: SGA_TARGET < SGA_MAX_SIZE AND cache hit ratio < 90% → recommend extending SGA_TARGET.
notes: Oracle AWR/ADDM access required. Not available via CSP native monitoring APIs.

metric_name: DB_CACHE_SIZE; DB_CACHE_ADVICE (recommended size); Buffer Hit Ratio
metric_collection_method: DB Observability Agent (Oracle EM or AWR)
agent_name: Oracle: SELECT * FROM v$db_cache_advice; v$sysstat (where name='db block gets' and name='consistent gets' and name='physical reads')
rule_trigger: Cache hit ratio < 95% AND DB_CACHE_ADVICE shows benefit from larger cache → increase DB_CACHE_SIZE.
notes: Oracle DB-level observability required.

metric_name: Logical Reads per second (AWR Load Profile); Logical Reads per transaction
metric_collection_method: DB Observability Agent (Oracle EM or AWR)
agent_name: Oracle AWR Load Profile: Logical reads per sec / per transaction | AWR top SQL report
rule_trigger: Logical reads per second > 50000 (or > 10x per-CPU baseline) → recommend SQL tuning or index analysis.
notes: High logical reads often caused by full table scans or Cartesian joins. AWR Top SQL identifies the culprit.

metric_name: Buffer Nowait %; Redo Nowait %; Library Cache Hit %; Dictionary Cache Hit %; Soft Parse %
metric_collection_method: DB Observability Agent (Oracle EM or AWR)
agent_name: Oracle: SELECT * FROM v$sysstat to compute: 1-(phy reads)/(db block gets + consistent gets) = cache hit ratio; soft parse ratio from v$sql
rule_trigger: Buffer Nowait < 99% OR Library Hit < 99% OR Soft Parse Ratio < 95% → recommend configuration tuning or increased SGA.

metric_name: Physical Reads per second; Physical Read Total IO Requests; Physical Read Bytes
metric_collection_method: DB Observability Agent (Oracle EM or AWR)
agent_name: Oracle AWR: Physical reads from Load Profile | v$sysstat physical reads
rule_trigger: Physical reads > threshold indicating cache miss or bad SQL → analyze and fix; may allow smaller EBS/storage tier.

metric_name: Hard Parses per second; Parses per second; Library Cache Hit Ratio
metric_collection_method: DB Observability Agent (Oracle EM or AWR)
agent_name: Oracle AWR Load Profile: Parses / Hard Parses per second | v$sql hard_parse_count
rule_trigger: Hard Parse ratio > 10% of total parses → recommend shared pool sizing or application bind variable review.

metric_name: Blob last access time; Blob age; Blob tier; Storage account config
native_api_name: Azure: Storage Blob LastAccessTime (requires enabling access time tracking per storage account via UpdateBlobServiceProperties) | Blob Properties API | Azure Monitor
rule_trigger: Blob last access > 30 days → Cool tier. > 90 days → Archive. Lifecycle rule missing → recommend creation.
notes: Last access tracking must be enabled via portal or API before historical data available.

metric_name: Storage class per bucket; Lifecycle configuration; Storage Lens metrics
native_api_name: AWS: S3 GetBucketLifecycleConfiguration + S3 Storage Lens AccountSnapshot (bucketsByStorageClass; notConfiguredIntelligentTiering) | S3 API HeadObject (storageClass)
rule_trigger: Bucket has no lifecycle rule AND has objects > 128 KB AND not already Intelligent-Tiering → recommend enabling S3 Intelligent-Tiering.

metric_name: EIP association status; Associated instance state
native_api_name: AWS: EC2 DescribeAddresses (all EIPs with allocationId) → check networkInterfaceId = null AND instanceId = null
rule_trigger: EIP is allocated AND not associated with running instance → recommend RELEASE.

technology: AWS Auto Scaling Groups; Azure VMSS; GCP MIG
metric_name: GroupInServiceInstances; CPUUtilization across ASG; Max CPU during non-peak hours; Scale-out event count
native_api_name: AWS: CloudWatch GroupInServiceInstances + CPUUtilization namespace=AWS/AutoScaling | Azure: Monitor Percentage CPU on VMSS | GCP: Cloud Monitoring instance/cpu/utilization on MIG
rule_trigger: Min capacity running instances avg CPU < 30% at baseline (non-peak window) for 14 days → reduce min capacity or downsize instance type.

technology: Azure Cosmos DB; Azure App Service; Azure Blob Storage
metric_name: On-demand usage hours by service tier; Reservation coverage %
native_api_name: Azure Advisor Recommendations API: GET /providers/Microsoft.Advisor/recommendations?filter=category eq 'Cost' AND type eq 'BuyReservedCapacity'
rule_trigger: On-demand spend > $300/month on eligible service for 30 days AND no reservation → recommend Azure reservation.

technology: AWS ALB/NLB; Azure LB; GCP Forwarding Rule
metric_name: HealthyHostCount; RequestCount; ActiveConnectionCount
native_api_name: AWS: CloudWatch HealthyHostCount namespace=AWS/ApplicationELB (= 0) + RequestCount | Azure: Monitor BackendHealthPercentage | GCP: Cloud Monitoring https/backend_latencies count
rule_trigger: HealthyHostCount = 0 OR RequestCount = 0 for 7 days → recommend DELETE.

metric_name: Instance running hours; Environment tag value
native_api_name: AWS: EC2 DescribeInstances (state=running + tag Environment=dev/test/staging) | Azure: VM list API | GCP: Compute Instances API
rule_trigger: Instance has environment tag = dev/test/staging AND no stop schedule configured → recommend scheduled start/stop.

metric_name: Compute Optimizer pre-computed recommendation; CPU/memory utilization; Performance risk level
native_api_name: AWS: Compute Optimizer API GetEC2InstanceRecommendations + GetLambdaFunctionRecommendations + GetEBSVolumeRecommendations + GetECSServiceRecommendations
rule_trigger: Compute Optimizer recommendation exists with performance risk = not-at-risk → surface recommendation and estimated savings.
notes: Memory recommendations require CloudWatch Agent. CPU-only recommendations available without agent.
